mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.25% for three consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.25% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 7.0%) and positive non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS increase > 0.5%) signal robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 7.0% and PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 700,000 units (HOUST > 700), rising residential investment supports consumer wealth and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 700, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate over the prior three months signals improving labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines by at least 0.2% over the prior three months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, manufacturing slowdown reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) indicate a stable monetary environment that encourages risk-taking and equity investment, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO < 96.0), declining industrial production signals weakening economic activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 96.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
